scope: Seven recent main-line experiments, plus separately linked historical anchors; not an exhaustive repo audit or a12h slice.
overall: No registered main method passed all scientific gates.

decision.evidence_scope: Feature-level adaptation of established replay/contrastive losses; not a new TMI contribution or independent clinical test.
Equal growing architecture with/without old branch freezing; DER-inspired feature adaptation, not a novel method or faithful full DER reproduction.
Birth-correct all-seen margin preservation vs ER/historical-logit matching; candidate mechanism, not established novelty or clinical efficacy.
Finite-memory class-CE feasible transitions; no unseen-patient risk guarantee, novelty claim or faithful GEM reproduction.

interpretation: Encoder calls repeat the same68058 training/300 development images across experiments; not unique patients or new downloaded data.
Trials differ in representation, memory and optimizer. Only within-trial matched contrasts are causal comparisons.
No absent metric is zero accuracy. Full acceptance, partial failure-record acceptance and preflight engineering failure are different.
Costs use final ledgers; first/retry/resume cumulative clocks are nested, not summed. Formal neural updates, L-BFGS updates/evaluations and synthetic steps remain separate.
Historical anchor costs remain in original ledgers and are not included in the seven-trial subtotal.
Reporting only reads saved aggregates and process receipts, with zero new encoding/model scoring/optimization.
